name: Reconcile payments
definition: Enable an organization to compare recorded payment obligations and transactions against authoritative payment records, identify discrepancies, and produce a reviewable reconciliation outcome.
capabilityPurpose: Maintain trustworthy financial records by detecting and resolving mismatches between expected and received payment information.

includes: Importing or receiving authoritative payment records
excludes: Writing off a balance without authorized review

meaningfulOutcome: A reconciliation run produces matched records and clearly identified discrepancies that can be reviewed or resolved by an authorized finance actor.

interactionContracts.name: Import payment records
interactionContracts.actor: Authorized scheduler, finance operator, or integration
interactionContracts.commandIntent: Make authoritative payment records available for reconciliation
interactionContracts.transition: Payment records become available for the reconciliation period

interactionContracts.name: Run payment reconciliation
interactionContracts.actor: Reconciliation service or authorized finance operator
interactionContracts.commandIntent: Compare payment records with recorded obligations
interactionContracts.currentState: Reconcilable payment records and obligations are available

policiesInvariants.text: A payment record must not be marked matched when required identifying evidence is absent.

interactionContracts.transition: Open reconciliation period to reconciled records and discrepancy cases
interactionContracts.result: Matched, unmatched, duplicate, or ambiguous payment outcomes

interactionContracts.name: Review payment discrepancy

policiesInvariants.text: Only an authorized finance actor may resolve or write off a discrepancy.

interactionContracts.transition: Discrepancy case remains open or is marked resolved with an audit note

rulesInvariants.text: Reconciliation outcomes must preserve sufficient evidence for an authorized reviewer to understand the match or discrepancy.

recommendedDefaults.text: Ambiguous matches should be surfaced for review rather than automatically marked reconciled.

realizations.name: Illustrative reconciliation service
realizations.rationaleIntent: An organization may implement this to improve financial-record integrity; this is not part of the reusable capability purpose.

provenance.text: This is an illustrative internal-capability example, not a specification for a particular financial system.

relatedMLEsByDimension.notes: The one human-facing touchpoint in an otherwise internal capability.
Illustrative; execution mode agent-primary-using-software; supports, not replaces, the finance operator's review authority.

relatedMLEsByDimension.ref: An unmatched record is never silently marked resolved; a duplicate payment is not reconciled twice

communicationMLEs.name: Discrepancy Escalation Notice
communicationMLEs.purpose: Alert the responsible finance operator that a payment discrepancy needs review, with enough context to act.
communicationMLEs.trigger: A discrepancy case is created by Run payment reconciliation (PaymentDiscrepancyDetected).

terminology.text: Call it a "discrepancy," never an "exception" or "anomaly," consistently across every realization.

toneStyle.text: Neutral and operational -- this is routine finance work, not an incident.

rules.text: Must not state or imply that a discrepancy has been resolved before an authorized finance actor has reviewed it.

recommendedDefaults.text: If a review-time expectation exists, state it; otherwise do not invent one.

exampleCopy.text: New discrepancy #4821 -- ambiguous match, $128.40. Review in the reconciliation queue.
